items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: He told me a story, Benny was playing one night...

ctx.x: Bill Highland. Yeah. He was the Attorney General in New Jersey at one time. And he became very friendly with Benny. He told me a story, Benny was playing one night and they’re doing a dance job. Benny took the clarinet out of his mouth and handed it to him to play, and he danced with his wife.
That’s great. When did he pass away? Was it ’86 or something like that?

items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I saw his lawyer the other night, he sat in with me.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I saw his lawyer the other night, he sat in with me. A good clarinet player.

Bill Highland. Yeah. He was the Attorney General in New Jersey at one time. And he became very friendly with Benny. He told me a story, Benny was playing one night and they’re doing a dance job. Benny took the clarinet out of his mouth and handed it to him to play, and he danced with his wife.
